content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Industrial and agricultural equipment for municipalities and farms; no overlap with recreational boat manufacturing."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"School and commercial buses sold to districts and fleets; a different product and customer base from recreational boats."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Roofing, insulation and industrial components sold to contractors and OEMs; unrelated to boats."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Automotive and truck replacement parts for aftermarket retailers; not recreational boats or boat accessories."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Pool and spa equipment sold to pool builders and owners; different products and customers despite leisure-water overlap."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Designs and builds recreational powerboats sold to consumers through independent dealers, the same model as the target."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber for construction; unrelated to recreational boats."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Pure distributor of pool supplies to trade customers; it does not manufacture boats or sell to boaters."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Firearms for shooters and law enforcement; different products and customers despite shared dealer channels."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Lawn, turf, snow and irrigation equipment sold to landscapers and homeowners; a different product line."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Recreational vehicles and buses sold through dealers; similar model but different products, not boats."}]}
